The comprehension kernel \mathcal{K}_{\text{comprehend}} aggregates weighted visual and temporal cues into a scalar measure of understanding. This is embedded in a teachability surface \mathcal{T} that transitions user states based on media fidelity. The help asset pipeline \mathcal{P} ensures that all assets conform to a four-component structure (explanation, next action, trust note, visual) to enable scalable internal reuse. These primitives form a dualistic system: one for external user cognition (GSE) and one for internal team coordination (GSI). Failure occurs when trust is broken (e.g., misleading visuals) or when the 10-second window is exceeded. The system is robust under small perturbations but collapses if any of the four components are missing.
